reuse.why: Uses the existing link.assertAccountNotLinked and link.findOrCreateBank helpers, BankSyncError, post/getServer and the syncAccount dispatcher; only the account upgrade/insert body has no shared helper and is written inline like the other providers.

duplication.why: The upgrade-or-insert account block, initial sync and sync-event notification are a near verbatim copy of linkAkahuAccount/linkEnableBankingAccount, and downloadFintegraTransactions copies the Akahu/EnableBanking download shape.

placement.why: Link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in accounts/sync.ts, server URL in server-config.ts, account type under types/models, exactly where the tree puts each provider.

scope.why: Focused on Fintegra; widening DbAccount.account_sync_source to include the existing pluggyai/akahu/enableBanking values is a small adjacent type fix beyond the request.

maintainability.why: Consistent with the existing per-provider pattern so easy to follow, but adds a sixth copy of the link body and a fifth near-identical download function instead of extracting the shared flow.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Routes the duplicate-link check and bank lookup through link.ts and syncing through bankSync.syncAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies in linkFintegraAccount (app.ts) and downloadFintegraTransactions (sync.ts) are plain copies of the sibling provider code, slightly trimmed, not disguised.
